author: n. a. sauceda
title: Tkachuk out as Panthers face Canadiens; Samoskevich moves to top line
text:
The Florida Panthers will play the Montreal Canadiens at Bell Centre on April 7, with forward Matthew Tkachuk absent from the lineup as he returns to South Florida for the birth of his first child. The game marks the start of the Canadian leg of Florida’s final road trip of the season.
With a record of 37-37-3 and several players sidelined by injuries, head coach Paul Maurice said, “We want to bounce back. We want to come out and play. It’s a tough situation for everybody, but we want to be proud of how we try in this game.”
Mackie Samoskevich will move up to join Sam Bennett and Carter Verhaeghe on the top line in Tkachuk’s absence. Maurice described their strength as “Speed,” adding about Samoskevich: “Mackie’s had a tough year. He’s played so much better than his stats.” Samoskevich has recently scored in four out of five games and noted about playing with Bennett, “He plays with a lot of pace, and that’s kind of one of my strengths… It’ll make for a good combination.”
Daniil Tarasov is set for his third consecutive start in goal for Florida, having appeared in 29 games this season with a 10-15-2 record. Meanwhile, Montreal enters with an already secured playoff spot and an eight-win streak recently ended by New Jersey. Nick Suzuki leads Montreal in scoring with 95 points.
Samoskevich spoke about facing Montreal at Bell Centre: “When you play here, it’s so fun… There’s always energy in the building. It might not be for you, but gives you energy and fires us up.” On defending against Montreal’s offense he said: “We just have to have the mindset to defend first and manage the puck… Just being smart.”
Maurice also commented on Aaron Ekblad joining morning skate despite injury: “He couldn’t move the puck very much. Good veteran captain… Was chirping everybody out there. We appreciate it.”
Looking ahead, both teams are managing roster changes late in their seasons while preparing for playoffs or off-season breaks.
